note: Bankivik's price book for Greenland (in force from 25 September 2026): a monthly account fee of 30 kroner on a private customer's first account, waived for customers under 29 and for those with deposits or custody holdings over 10,000 kroner (written as a balance never below 10,000.01); the waiver for a salary account isn't written.

sources.title: Bankivik, Prisbog Grønland (in force from 25 September 2026)
sources.said: Prisbog Grønland Gældende fra 25. september 2026 ... Månedligt kontogebyr - første konto 30 kr. ... Kunder under 29 år, kunder med lønkonto samt kunder med indlån eller depotværdier over 10.000 kr. er undtaget fra dette kontogebyr.
